prompts.name: tumour-overlay
prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational, compositing. Make a SEGMENTATION OVERLAY ONLY for the supplied front-facing human wireframe. It will be composited on top of the exact original image in HTML. Preserve the exact 1024x1536 transparent canvas, body pose, scale and placement, do not crop to contents or recenter the layer. The reference body occupies x220-805 and y20-1470. Output only the requested coloured anatomical tissue mesh in its anatomically correct positions. Remove ALL original ivory outer human wireframe lines, head, hands, feet, skin, organs and background from the output; these will remain in a separate underlying layer. Everything except the requested tissue must be truly transparent alpha, including empty background above, below and around the structures. Premium very fine wireframe 3D contour/surface mesh, restrained translucent colour, not opaque solids, no glow or halo, no fog, no invented text or arrows. No white outlines, legends, axis, labels, borders, floor, gradients or decorative neon. Render a coherent medical teaching illustration, not measured patient data.Show ONLY THREE small coral (#e36b63) 3D wire-mesh tumour nodules, irregular rounded mesh masses: approximately centred at x453,y354 with diameter65px (patient right upper chest), x447,y535 with diameter82px (patient right upper abdomen), and x523,y691 with diameter42px (pelvic region). Fine contour lines with subtle translucent coral fill, each a separate three-dimensional lesion. Preserve these exact positions and sizes within original full canvas. Do not include any other anatomy.
